[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | collector = y }} [[Watchtower Coast]] is a relatively peaceful area in northern [[Kryta]], named for the ancient watchtowers that dot the landscape. The towers, legend has it, were built to fend off some unknown threat from across [[Giant's Basin]], but their true purpose remains unknown. ==Exits== Leaving east from [[Divinity Coast (outpost)|Divinity Coast]] or north from [[Beetletun]] will take you here. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *Center South, a terrace above the path from [[Divinity Coast]]. *Southeast, at the exit into [[Beetletun]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 2 (20) [[Farmer Fanella]] *{{x}} 1 (20) [[Tenlach Silverhand]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Abnormal Seed]]s) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Ian Sturmme]] (collector for 5 [[Feathered Caromi Scalp]]s) ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 [[Lynx]] ===Foes=== [[Gargoyle]]s *{{me}} 14 (24) [[Mergoyle]] *{{e}} 12 (24) [[Mergoyle Wavebreaker]] [[Plant]]s *{{r}} 13 (24) [[Oakheart (Kryta)]] *{{mo}} 11 (24) [[Spined Aloe]] [[Skale]] *{{n}} 11 (24) [[Bog Skale]] [[Tengu]] ([[Caromi]]) *{{w}} 13 (24) [[Caromi Tengu Brave]] *{{r}} 13 (24) [[Caromi Tengu Scout]] *{{me}} 13 (24) [[Caromi Tengu Wild]] ====Bosses==== [[Gargoyle]]s *{{mo}} 15 (28) [[Gack Splotchplunk]] *{{me}} 15 (28) [[Hew Gruntruck]] [[Skale]] *{{r}} 15 (28) [[Melp the Harpooner]] *{{n}} 15 (28) [[Eepeep the Mindrain]] *{{e}} 15 (28) [[Fauul the Windburner]] == Notes == *These quests will affect the spawns in this area: **[[The Undead Hordes]] * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.97% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. * This is the only explorable area in Prophecies that cannot be reached via [[Vanquisher#Larger_party_sizes|caravan]] by a [[party]] of 8. *{{Vanquisher|count = 160|low = 135|high = 176|notes=There are usually a few hidden Spined Aloes near the Oakhearts.}} ** [[The Undead Hordes]] will increase the number of foes in this area. {{Explorable areas in Kryta}} [[de:Wachturmküste]]
